visualReview.notes: Inspected 11 current portable views, including the retained 1024×640 summary. The retained stepped envelope, low white western wing, taller eastern hall, opaque pointed screen fields and doors, slim pilasters with green caps, white ribbed dome with coarse green fields, slender faceted minaret with two gallery sections, open lanterns and bronze crescent finials are present. Pilasters were placed between the screen fields. Fine inscriptions, historic ornament, garden, fencing, street furniture, adjacent buildings and furnished interiors are omitted. The source-terrain view exposes deep footing faces on coarse coastal grade; these are approximate contact geometry, not surveyed retaining walls.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected 11 current shared-material/geographic-flat views, including the placement overlay. Six existing 256² graphs provide lime plaster, raw/coursed limestone, painted metal, ceramic and bronze; seven merged roles include local opaque glazing. Metric UVs and linear tints, no embedded images or unique atlas. Each graph is read once and eviction disposes the model geometry. Precise subtraction uses the current mapped building footprint and retains all 35 neighbors; the model envelope and ground mask use the slightly different retained outline. The flat overlay verifies approximate pose and replacement, not surveyed terrain contact.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected 27 current medium-fi views: Economy/High, noon/late light, street/block/skyline, silhouette, six details, four matched LODs and four transitions. The stepped white mass, dome and two-gallery minaret remain legible. Skyline keeps the full envelope, coarse dome/green fields, four-post open galleries and simple finial tips. District adds opaque fields, trim and crescent silhouettes. Street restores screen grids, dome ribs and further facets; closeup adds finer ribs/crescents and pilaster details. Whole views retain the tower; some detail cameras intentionally crop it. Context houses are synthetic and the surrounding terrain fixture is illustrative. Physical laptop/phone/tablet and full-city timings remain unmeasured.
